name: Camerino (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, the white charged at the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Camerino (a white castle on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Camerino, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Camerino arms — white castle on red, crowned, within branches
